title: The Kalopaideia Italian Examination
instructions: Three hours, no notes for Part A; printed lexicon and grammar permitted for Part B. Honor code: you affirm by submitting that you used only permitted aids. A failed examination may be retaken after thirty days.

items.prompt_italian:
Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita
mi ritrovai per una selva oscura,
ché la diritta via era smarrita.
items.prompt_en: Translate this tercet from Dante, Inferno I.
reference: in the middle of the journey of our life i found myself in a dark wood for the straight way was lost
midway upon the journey of our life i found myself within a dark wood for the right way was lost
in the middle of the road of our life i found myself in a dark forest because the straight path was lost

items.prompt_italian:
Amor, ch'al cor gentil ratto s'apprende,
prese costui de la bella persona
che mi fu tolta; e 'l modo ancor m'offende.
items.prompt_en: Translate this tercet from Dante, Inferno V (Francesca speaks).
reference: love which to the gentle heart swiftly attaches itself took hold of this one for the beautiful person that was taken from me and the manner still offends me
love that quickly seizes the gentle heart took hold of him for the fair form that was taken from me and the way still wounds me
love which attaches itself swiftly to the noble heart seized this man for the beautiful body taken from me and the manner still offends me

items.prompt_italian: Umana cosa è aver compassione degli afflitti; e come che a ciascuna persona stea bene, a coloro è massimamente richiesto li quali già hanno di conforto avuto mestiere e hannol trovato in alcuni.
items.prompt_en: Translate this sentence from Boccaccio, Decameron, Proemio (opening).
reference: it is a human thing to have compassion for the afflicted and while it becomes every person it is especially required of those who have once had need of comfort and have found it in others
to have compassion for the suffering is a human thing and although it befits everyone it is most especially required of those who have had need of consolation and have found it in some
it is human to have pity on the afflicted and though it suits all people it is most necessary for those who once needed comfort and found it in certain people

items.prompt_italian: Tutti li stati, tutti e' dominii che hanno avuto et hanno imperio sopra li uomini, sono stati e sono o repubbliche o principati.
items.prompt_en: Translate the opening sentence of Machiavelli, Il Principe, chapter I.
reference: all states all dominions that have had and have empire over men have been and are either republics or principalities
all the states all the domains that have had and have authority over men were and are either republics or principalities
all states all governments that have had and have power over men have been and are either republics or principalities

items.prompt: Parse the verb form parlò. Give: person, number, tense, mood, voice.
Parse the verb form avesse parlato. Give: person, number, tense, mood, voice.
Parse the noun form libri. Give: case (nominative/accusative), number, gender, singular form.
Parse the pronoun form glielo. Give: the two component pronouns and their functions.
answer: gli (indirect object, to him/her/them) + lo (direct object, it/him)

items.prompt: Render in Italian: 'Dante is a great poet.'
reference: Dante è un grande poeta
Dante è grande poeta
Dante è un gran poeta

items.prompt: Render in Italian: 'The woman gave the book to the child.'
reference: La donna ha dato il libro al bambino
La donna diede il libro al bambino
La donna ha dato il libro al ragazzo

items.prompt: Render in Italian: 'If I had known, I would have come.'
reference: Se avessi saputo, sarei venuto
Se lo avessi saputo, sarei venuto
Se avessi saputo, sarei venuta
